task: Synthesize the supplied arXiv abstracts into a 1–3 page research landscape.

nuggets.text: Exploration-Distillation separates novelty-rewarded RLVR exploration from student optimization by filtering explorer trajectories and distilling them into a student trained without novelty bonuses, avoiding degradation from aggressive exploration.

For smooth nonconvex objectives with bounded p-th-moment noise, 1 < p <= 2, clipped decentralized SGD achieves order-optimal convergence and linear speedup across agents; normalized decentralized SGD can fail to converge.
VLA success can depend sharply on instruction wording: on LIBERO, pi_0.5 succeeds 100% of the time for 'switch on the stove' but 2% for 'switch on the hot plate'.
Rewriting instructions once using 10–20 LLM-distilled phrasing rules improves frozen pi_0 success by 16–27% relative across twelve held-out tasks, without policy retraining or per-step verification.

G^2MLP uses curvature-guided distillation to address sparse-graph spectral underfit and dense-graph spectral overfit, transferring teacher graph geometry into an MLP that requires no graph at inference.

Forget-only unlearning cannot always reproduce retraining because ordinary learning may discard information needed for deletion; supporting arbitrary deletions can require retaining information as large as the entire dataset.

SciExam for ENSO evaluates six-hour scientific model-building runs using frozen, agent-written diagnostics and hidden tests of climate statistics, unobserved-variable recovery, and forecasting of held-out years.
Six of twelve agent systems in SciExam for ENSO produce models scoring above a published model, with advantages mainly in reconstruction and forecasting.

Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader enables agnostic smoothed online learning with sublinear regret and one ERM oracle call per round, without knowing the base measure, smoothing parameter, or horizon.

Holding Sentinel-2 features and the lake-level split fixed, evolutionary architecture search raises held-out AUC from 0.790 to 0.820 with a 409-parameter classifier, using 26 times fewer parameters than the strongest hand-designed reference.

Adversarial common reward shifts can break GLRT-based best-arm stopping rules even when arm gaps remain fixed; importance-weighted ISM restores delta-correct identification with matching worst-case sample-complexity bounds under bounded means and sub-Gaussian rewards.

Standard two-level softmax sampling misweights clusters by ignoring size imbalance and within-cluster dispersion; S-2LS and SD-2LS correct these effects to improve approximation with little or no additional computation.

Delta-MOPD transfers teacher-minus-base logit shifts anchored to the student's frozen initialization, isolating post-training changes from inherited teacher-base preferences in multi-teacher distillation.

NeuralBES uses a shared building-metadata encoder to parameterize physically bounded resistance-capacitance thermal models, supporting differentiable annual simulations that preserve physical validity across heterogeneous buildings.

JOLT jointly trains a privileged self-teacher with rewards and KL regularization toward the student, and an unprivileged student with dense on-policy distillation, addressing harmful guidance from teacher shortcuts unavailable to the student.

Seq-Flow learns transport from the previous forecast distribution to its update, using self-rollout training to control errors introduced by repeatedly reusing model-generated forecasts as flow initializations.
SQAM removes expensive per-step vector–Jacobian products from flow-policy fine-tuning through a scalar adjoint, paired with a critic-value penalty at policy-generated actions.

Conditional flow matching generates stochastic three-dimensional urban wind and temperature fields in seconds, using overlapping regions with shared noise to reduce GPU memory demands while maintaining spatial continuity.

A derivative-GP approximation compresses gradients at m neighboring inputs in d dimensions from md coordinates to at most 2m directional derivatives, yielding O(m^3) dense factorization per prediction.

In BehaviorTrace's three-seed Qwen2.5-1.5B GRPO study, gradient magnitude and fluency confound apparent training-rollout attribution; after fluency control, per-rollout results remain unstable across seeds and generation draws.
SteerSpeech trains lightweight low-rank activation transforms for continuous emotion control while keeping the TTS backbone frozen and constraining changes to speaker identity and linguistic content.

Expected Decoding Rounds models parallel and semi-autoregressive speculative decoding as a Markov reward process, accounting for cross-round acceptance dependencies and exactly targeting the expected number of decoding rounds.

integration_facts.text: Distillation increasingly centers on selecting information appropriate for the student: ExpDis filters exploratory trajectories, G^2MLP preserves graph geometry, Delta-MOPD isolates post-training shifts, and JOLT adapts privileged teachers to student capabilities.

The theory papers extend learning guarantees under explicitly structured uncertainty: heavy-tailed decentralized noise, agnostic smoothed online inputs, and adversarial common reward shifts. Their guarantees depend on moment, smoothing, or stable-gap assumptions rather than unrestricted robustness.

Flow-based models recur across forecasting, action policies, and turbulence generation. Their practical bottlenecks differ: Seq-Flow addresses repeated forecast updates, SQAM reduces policy-gradient computation, and urban flow matching reduces memory demands for three-dimensional generation.

Evaluation extends beyond aggregate performance scores to tests matched to the claimed capability: SciExam uses hidden scientific checks, NeuralBES assesses physical validity, and BehaviorTrace uses planted causes and confound controls to interrogate attribution claims.

Fast sampling and decoding expose problems with local approximations that omit global structure: two-level softmax ignores cluster mass and dispersion, while drafter-training surrogates ignore cross-round dependence. The proposed corrections improve distributional fidelity or directly optimize total expected rounds.

Control can improve while backbone weights remain frozen: VLA instruction rewriting changes the input, whereas SteerSpeech changes hidden activations. Their training requirements differ: rewriting needs no policy retraining, while SteerSpeech trains lightweight transforms.

Scientific-model efficiency benefits from compact representations tailored to the task: architecture search finds a tiny spectral-feature classifier, NeuralBES encodes bounded thermal physics, and derivative GPs retain prediction-relevant gradient directions while reducing computation.

answer_key.q: What common change is being made to distillation and RL post-training?
answer_key.a: Transfer is becoming selective and student-aware: ExpDis separates exploration, G^2MLP aligns graph geometry, Delta-MOPD transfers post-training logit shifts, and JOLT regularizes privileged teachers toward students.

answer_key.q: How severe is VLA language sensitivity, and can control improve with a frozen backbone?
answer_key.a: A wording change produces a reported 100%-to-2% success swing. Policy-specific instruction rewrites improve frozen VLAs; speech emotion control similarly uses a frozen backbone, but trains small activation transforms.

answer_key.q: Why do flow models recur, and how are their computational costs controlled?
answer_key.a: They represent rich forecast, action, and turbulent-field distributions. Seq-Flow transports prior forecasts with self-rollout training, SQAM eliminates per-step vector–Jacobian products, and urban flow matching uses overlapping regions with shared noise.

answer_key.q: What makes evaluation convincing for scientific models and learned behaviors?
answer_key.a: Use checks matched to the claim: hidden climate statistics, reconstruction, and forecasts in SciExam; physical validity in NeuralBES; and planted behaviors, confound controls, and repeated seeds in BehaviorTrace.

answer_key.q: What do softmax sampling and speculative decoding reveal about efficiency objectives?
answer_key.a: Local shortcuts can miss global structure. Softmax approximations need cluster-size and dispersion corrections; drafter training needs cross-round acceptance dependencies. EDR exactly targets expected decoding rounds.

answer_key.q: Which assumptions support the new theoretical guarantees, and what information limit remains?
answer_key.a: Clipped DSGD assumes bounded p-th moments; smoothed online learning retains a density-bound assumption; ISM requires stable arm gaps under common shifts. Forget-only unlearning can fail when training discarded information needed for deletion.
